title: An open domain containing a punctured 2-plane, avoiding the other planes, whose trace on the plane is connected
statement: Let P, q ∈ ℕ, let P_1, …, P_q (a family Ps : Fin q → Submodule ℝ ℝ^P) be linear subspaces of ℝ^P, and let i ∈ Fin q be such that dim P_i = 2 and P_i ∩ P_j = {0} (Ps i ⊓ Ps j = ⊥) for every j ≠ i. Then there is an open set V ⊆ ℝ^P such that V ∩ P_i is connected, P_i ∖ {0} ⊆ V, and V is disjoint from P_j for every j ≠ i.
lean_statement: ∀ (P q : ℕ) (Ps : Fin q → Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (i : Fin q), Module.finrank ℝ (Ps i) = 2 → (∀ j, j ≠ i → Ps i ⊓ Ps j = ⊥) → ∃ V : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen V ∧ IsConnected (V ∩ (Ps i : Set (Euclid P))) ∧ (Ps i : Set (Euclid P)) \ {0} ⊆ V ∧ ∀ j, j ≠ i → Disjoint V (Ps j : Set (Euclid P))
